Tower door: the small door in the south porch. It is unlocked from 19:00 on practice nights and from 9:00 on Sundays.
Parking: the church car park is for the Sunday congregation. On practice nights park in Mill Lane.
Stairs: 38 spiral steps, narrow, with a rope handrail. Wear flat shoes.
Ropes: tuck your sally into your belt when you stand down. Never leave a rope loose.
Beginners: ask the tower captain before you take a rope. Visitors who can ring plain hunt are welcome straight away.
